native.marketing.reviews.whitney: This is awesome product to get your favorite music sheet, learn along and features of controlling the speeds, marking and selecting you favorite sheet and soo many others feature. love it.... ❤
native.marketing.reviews.lucy: Easy to use and great for finding sheet music for any instrument! There is a passionate community of creators in MuseScore. The subscription is really worth it and is way more than what you pay for!
native.marketing.reviews.jacob: This has been such a great resource for learning a wide variety of material, mostly within the American song-book tradition. There are many official scores which are often hard to find. There are user-generated versions of arrangements which are sometimes helpful.
native.marketing.tour_update.review_mark: I’ve got stacks of old scores. Now I can scan them and actually use them in practice again.
native.marketing.tour_update.review_lisa: Preparing material for students is way faster now. One photo and it’s ready for class.
native.marketing.tour_update.review_juli: Changing keys for singers was such a pain. Now I just scan and transpose in seconds
